title: Addressing "Documentation Debt" in Machine Learning Research: A Retrospective Datasheet for BookCorpus

bias_targets.methodology: Tabulating the frequency of books associated with specific religious subjects (e.g., Christianity, Islam, Judaism) using dataset metadata to identify over- or under-representation of religious viewpoints.

Qualitative evaluation of genre skews (specifically the over-representation of romance novels) and the identification of explicit content containing stereotypical gender tropes (e.g., tags like 'alpha male' and 'submissive female').
